findings.title: Dynamic imports are executed eagerly when the appStore module loads
findings.body: The object literal uses `import("./applecalendar")` etc. as property values. Dynamic `import()` expressions are evaluated immediately, so every app chunk starts loading as soon as this index module is imported, even if no app is ever requested. This defeats lazy loading and can significantly increase startup/bundle loading cost. Use lazy accessor functions, e.g. `applecalendar: () => import("./applecalendar")`, and update consumers to call and await them.

findings.title: Unawaited async forEach leaves calendar deletions unperformed in recurring cancellation
findings.body: In the recurring `allRemainingBookings` branch, `forEach(async (credential) => { ... const deletedEvent = await calendar?.deleteEvent(...); apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent); })` discards the returned promises. Because `forEach` does not await async callbacks, `apiDeletes` is still empty when later `Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` runs, so external calendar events for the remaining recurring bookings are not reliably cancelled/awaited. Replace with a real loop or `await Promise.all(credentials.map(async ...))` and collect the deletion promises.

findings.title: Calendar/video deletion promises are fire-and-forget
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... const calendar = await getCalendar(...); return calendar?.deleteEvent(...); })` ignores the async callbacks' returned promises. The function can send the reschedule email and return before the calendar/video deletions complete, and rejections from `getCalendar` or `deleteEvent` become unhandled. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(async ...))` or a `for...of` loop with awaited calls.

findings.title: Calendar/video deletion promises are fire-and-forget
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... const calendar = await getCalendar(...); return calendar?.deleteEvent(...); })` ignores the async callbacks' returned promises. The function can send the reschedule email and return before the calendar/video deletions complete, and rejections from `getCalendar` or `deleteEvent` become unhandled. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(async ...))` or a `for...of` loop with awaited calls.

findings.title: Calendar/video deletion promises are fire-and-forget
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... const calendar = await getCalendar(...); return calendar?.deleteEvent(...); })` ignores the async callbacks' returned promises. The request can continue and complete before the calendar/video deletions finish, and rejections from `getCalendar` or `deleteEvent` become unhandled. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(async ...))` or a `for...of` loop with awaited calls.
